Prototype rules

What is treated as evidence in this version.

  • Protocol and SAP links resolve to a section and page.
  • CRF links resolve to an annotated field on a specific page.
  • Raw and analysis variables come from metadata.xlsx.
  • SDTM nodes use aCRF annotations when a separate mapping spec is unavailable.
  • SPI-611 mock outputs embedded in the SAP take precedence over the SPI-515 reference shell.
